question.stem: The starting annual salary for an office worker at a company is $29,000. If the company awards an annual increase of 6.2%, which graph models this situation after the office worker receives x annual increases?

options.label: B
options.text: [Graph B: Steep curve sharply increasing near y-axis and exceeding 50,000 quickly]
